name: Entity Collision & Movement
aliases: Entity Movement with Sub-stepping and Collision Resolution
definition: Handles entity physics including gravity, ground detection, and axis-aligned movement with wall-sliding collision detection against voxel blocks.
summary: Entity Collision & Movement is a discrete-time physics solver for voxel environments that handles collision detection, response, and movement with sub-stepping, distinguishing itself from simple grid checks by integrating gravity, ground detection, and axis-aligned wall-sliding.
